app_fee.value: No application fee for School of Science and Engineering PhD programs.
app_fee.quote: there are no application fees for our PhD, MS, or Graduate Certificate programs

gre_general.value: The School of Science and Engineering does not require the GRE.

gre_subject.value: The GRE is not required for School of Science and Engineering applicants.

toefl_min.value: The neuroscience PhD does not require TOEFL or IELTS for admission.
toefl_min.quote: Because TOEFL and IELTS are not required

ielts_min.value: The neuroscience PhD does not require TOEFL or IELTS for admission.
ielts_min.quote: Because TOEFL and IELTS are not required

supervisor.value: Advised to identify at least one faculty member whose research matches theirs before applying.
supervisor.quote: it is helpful to identify at least one faculty member who has a background and research in the area in which you are most interested in studying

funding.value: The school offers teaching or research assistantships to all incoming PhD students.
funding.quote: offers Teaching Assistantships and/or Research Assistantships to all incoming PhD students

entry_route.value: Applicants need an undergraduate degree before starting; no master's is listed as required.
entry_route.quote: Earned an undergraduate degree from an accredited institution prior to the first semester of proposed graduate study

deadline.value: Application materials must be received by January 1, 2027; the School table lists January 5.
deadline.quote: All Ph.D. application materials must be received by the Neuroscience Graduate Program by January 1st

english_waiver.value: No English test is needed to apply; accepted international students take an ESL evaluation in July.
english_waiver.quote: Because TOEFL and IELTS are not required

notes: The department page says no TOEFL or IELTS is required, while the School page says all graduate applicants must show English proficiency. The department value is used.
